cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-help-stays-in-reader
cases.purpose: Both help entries show effective labelled keys in the reader, preserve business state and restore focus after layered Escape or backdrop dismissal.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-new-session-is-headless
cases.purpose: A session built without a buffer starts on the shelf, shows the detail pane and sends no request.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-refresh-loads-shelf-account-and-stats
cases.purpose: Refreshing loads the shelf rows, the account name and the reading statistics into one visible state.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-login-sends-the-login-request-and-reloads
cases.purpose: Signing in sends the login request with the longer login deadline and, once it succeeds, reloads the account and the shelf into the reader.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-logout-forgets-the-account-and-names-the-command
cases.purpose: Signing out sends the logout request, drops the account, statistics and loaded rows, and names the Emacs login command in the status line.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-login-failure-names-the-emacs-command
cases.purpose: A backend failure that needs a login is reported with the Emacs login command instead of the backend's command line.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-sections-are-navigable
cases.purpose: Every sidebar section opens and names itself, and an unknown section signals without changing the current one.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-filter-selects-shelf-section
cases.purpose: The shelf filter selects the matching section, sends the backend filter and rejects an unknown one.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-search-trims-and-rejects-blank
cases.purpose: Searching trims the keyword, shows the store results and rejects a blank keyword without a request.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-selection-keeps-its-page
cases.purpose: Selection clamps at both ends and opening the selected book publishes its detail.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-show-book-loads-detail-and-chapters
cases.purpose: Showing a book publishes its detail and chapter list, and a cached book is not requested twice.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-notes-group-and-attach-thoughts
cases.purpose: Highlights group by chapter, a matching thought attaches to its highlight and an orphan thought collects under its own heading.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-panes-toggle-and-load-notes
cases.purpose: The side pane switches between detail and highlights, loading the highlights on first use, and rejects an unknown pane.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-press-row-selects-then-opens
cases.purpose: A press selects another row and pressing the selected row opens it; an out-of-range row signals.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-reader-url-and-open-book
cases.purpose: Reader URLs prefer the backend deep link, fall back to the book id, and opening hands the URL to browse-url.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-export-notes-sends-the-export-request
cases.purpose: Exporting the selected book sends the export request and reports the backend conclusion.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-index-stores-and-searches-highlights
cases.purpose: Reading highlights stores them in the SQLite index, and the index section filters them by keyword.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-index-notebook-walks-and-skips-indexed
cases.purpose: The notebook walk fetches each unindexed book once, skips indexed books on a repeat run and re-fetches them when refreshed.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-index-upsert-updates-a-changed-thought
cases.purpose: Re-indexing a changed thought updates the stored row through upsert instead of adding a duplicate.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-backend-failure-is-reported-not-signaled
cases.purpose: A failing backend reply lands in the session error and message while the reader stays usable.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-missing-backend-script-is-reported
cases.purpose: A client whose backend script is missing reports the failure instead of signaling.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-theme-tokens-cover-both-palettes
cases.purpose: Every palette key resolves in both modes, an unknown key signals and the UI tokens follow the selected mode.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-format-duration-and-progress-bar
cases.purpose: Reading time and the text progress bar keep their documented shapes, including the empty and full ends.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-mount-renders-and-revives
cases.purpose: Mounting paints the shelf into a buffer, and killing that buffer lets the same session mount again.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-status-hints-fit-their-layout
cases.purpose: The wide status bar and the compact tab row each paint their binding hint whole, so no layout clips the summary off.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-section-switches-return-to-the-list-on-compact
cases.purpose: Switching section or running a store search brings the list pane back on a compact frame, while a wide frame keeps the pane the reader was showing.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-ret-opens-the-selection
cases.purpose: RET activates a Host under point and otherwise opens the selected book, so selecting with the arrows and pressing RET follows the documented contract.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-pane-keys-scroll-the-pane
cases.purpose: SPC and M-v scroll a long table-of-contents pane from the keyboard, which the wheel alone cannot do.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-replaced-keys-run-the-reader-command
cases.purpose: Keys the renderer also binds (n, q, PageUp/PageDown) run the reader command instead of a renderer scroll, so the documented keyboard contract holds.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-open-and-close-own-a-buffer
cases.purpose: Opening installs the reader keymap, hides the mode line and paints the shelf; closing kills the buffer.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-open-fills-the-selected-window
cases.purpose: Opening the reader replaces the selected window instead of splitting the frame into a second pane.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-default-client-runs-the-backend-script
cases.purpose: The default client runs the backend script with the documented arguments for a shelf filter, an export with its directory, a login and a logout.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-backend-refusal-reports-its-own-message
cases.purpose: A refused backend command surfaces its own JSON message, code and hint even though the exit event can arrive before the output; a crash without JSON keeps the exit status.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-backend-timeout-and-cancel
cases.purpose: A slow backend request times out with its command line as the hint, and a cancelled request never calls back.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-cached-list-refreshes-without-a-loading-state
cases.purpose: A cached list is shown at once and compared in the background without a loading state; a changed reply replaces the rows and the reader keeps its place.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-prefetch-warms-lists-and-stops-on-close
cases.purpose: A mounted reader warms unopened sidebar lists in the background, opens a warmed section without a loading state, and cancels the timer when the buffer is killed.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-prefetch-pauses-while-hidden
cases.purpose: A reader whose buffer no window shows pauses background refreshes, and showing it again resumes them.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-auth-failure-pauses-refreshes
cases.purpose: A background refresh failing with an auth error pauses the warmer until a foreground load succeeds.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-declares-its-palette-to-a-host
cases.purpose: A reader mounted under a host declares its palette, mode labels and mode cell there, and its own theme cycle writes the same cell the host's switch writes.

cases.name: etaf-weread-tests-keys-belong-to-the-root-host
cases.purpose: The reader's keys and its recorded session travel with its View, so a host that mounts it without etaf-app-open keeps working keys and can resolve the mounted reader.
